rationale: CR-001 is resolved. index_single_entity now passes fail_fast=True, so a single-entity publish failure propagates to the caller, which logs an error. Progress still moves only for new entities. Covered by test_single_entity_publish_propagates_error and test_single_entity_publish_moves_progress_on_success. The fix-up also corrects a runtime bug found during the fix: the skip-log extra key 'name' collided with a reserved LogRecord attribute and raised KeyError. It is renamed to entity_name and pinned by a test that uses the real logger. No new high-risk issue was introduced. Fix-up evidence: 45 targeted tests pass and ruff is clean.
